question: **What is the main idea or theme of this passage?**

options.text: Telangana’s yields of paddy have exceeded all expectations.
Recently, Telangana has seen a huge increase in the quantity of agricultural products.
The state of Telangana has emerged as a significant contributor to the growth of agriculture in the country.
Telangana has already become the ‘Rice Bowl of India’.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The state of Telangana has emerged as a significant contributor to the growth of agriculture in the country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence in the first paragraph of the given passage states, ***"With an impressive growth in yields, Telangana now claims to be transforming into the rice bowl of India."***
 
• The term **"Rice bowl of a specific country"** means an area in which abundant quantities of rice are grown.
 
• The second sentence in the first paragraph of the given passage also states, ***"******The Food Corporation of India (FCI) has procured 52 lakh tonnes of paddy from Telangana alone, which is more than half of the national target of 91 lakh tonnes."***
 
• It is also said in the given passage that according to the Telangana Planning Department, Paddy production is up 93%, maize is about 95%, and cotton is near about 74%
 
• From the points mentioned above, we can easily say that the main idea or theme of the passage is, **"****The state of Telangana has emerged as a significant contributor to the growth of agriculture in the country."**

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
